instruction: Query the OQMD database for all Zn-O binary polymorphs (element_set=Zn,O), sorted by delta_e, save total count, most stable and least stable entries to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_16.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
